desk.title: Review desk
desk.offline: Offline. Text is kept on this device; signing and messages wait for the connection.
desk.aiNote: Organised by AI from the patient's words. Not confirmed by a physician and not an assessment.
desk.patientEdited: The patient edited it before sending.
desk.showSource: Show the source in the conversation: {{line}}
desk.noSummaryBody: The patient is still answering, or this conversation produced no summary. The conversation is available.
desk.objectiveNote: Recorded values only. Nothing was examined before the visit.
desk.followUpNote: Fields not collected and unclear statements. No diagnoses.

hint.assessment: Written by the physician. AI never fills this in.
hint.plan: Tests, treatment and follow-up. Change doses or medicines at the visit.
hint.patient_message: The patient sees this after signing, with the physician's name.

note.diffLabel: Differences between the AI draft and the current text
note.diffKey: Underlined text was added; struck text was in the AI draft.
note.rebuilt: The draft was rebuilt from the summary.
note.physicianOnly: Assessment, plan and the message are written by the physician. Coordinators can complete S and O.
note.signPhysician: Physicians sign. Complete S and O, then assign it to a physician.
note.notSent: The patient has not sent the previsit. It can be signed after that.
note.saved: Version saved; colleagues can see it
note.signBody: The note is locked, the patient is notified and sees the message to them. Later corrections are addenda.
note.noMessage: The message to the patient is blank. They will only see that the previsit was reviewed.
note.historyNote: Typing is saved as a draft only you can see. "Save version" shares it with colleagues.
note.addendumHint: Write what is corrected or added. It carries your name and time and cannot be changed.
note.conflictBody: Both texts are kept. Choose what stays before saving or signing.
note.deviceTitle: Another device has a newer draft
note.deviceBody: Both drafts are kept. Choose what stays.

body.ask: Sent in this conversation, from clinic staff.
body.earlier: Sent in this conversation, from clinic staff. The patient or the desk changes the booking.
body.er: This is the fixed emergency wording; you can add to it. Call the patient if it is urgent.
body.phone: Kept in the clinic's contact log. Not sent to the patient.

action.messageHint: The patient sees it at once, with your name and title.
action.phoneHint: Who you spoke to, what was said and what happens next.

phoneQuick.family: Spoke with family, who will tell the patient.

thread.modeMe: Taken over. The AI is paused and people reply.

thread.releaseTitle: Hand {{name}}'s conversation back to the AI?

thread.taken: Taken over; the AI is paused
thread.noReply: This account cannot reply to patients.
thread.cannedHint: You can edit it after adding

received.body: We received your message and will reply after checking.

time.body: The doctor is seeing patients and expects to reply before the end of today. If you get worse, please seek care directly.

pharmacy.body: Collect your medicine at the pharmacy you chose in the request, and bring your health insurance card.

log.lede: Which tools, model and tokens each reply used, and what the program's rules found.

rx.title: Renewal review
rx.emptyBody: Renewal requests and questions from pharmacists appear here.
rx.footPhysician: A physician decides every medicine. The check is not an approval.
rx.footCoordinator: You can assign, message and contact patients. Physicians decide.
rx.notApproval: The check only lists rules that fired. It is not an approval; the physician decides.
rx.doseNote: As in the prescription record. Doses and medicines cannot be changed here.
rx.approveNoPharmacy: The patient has not chosen a pharmacy. Ask for it first.
rx.approveExcluded: This medicine is not accepted online.

noteHint.override: The check points the other way. Write what you based this on. Clinic staff only.
noteHint.question: The patient sees this. The request returns here after the reply.
noteHint.reason: The patient sees this. You can write it in the message below instead.

problem.undecided: Choose a decision for this medicine.
problem.no_pharmacy: The patient has not chosen a pharmacy, so it cannot be agreed. Ask for more information.
problem.question: Write the question.
problem.reason: Write the reason here or in the message to the patient.

build.title: What to ask the patient
build.body: Ticked lines are added as text you can still edit.
build.fresh: Please give your latest {{label}} and its date.

ready.reading: Please measure your blood pressure for three days and note time and numbers.
ready.photo: Please write down the medicine name and daily use printed on the bag.
ready.timing: Please tell us when it started and whether it is still there.
ready.other: Do you take other medicines, herbal medicine or supplements now?

rx.resultNone: Choose a decision for every medicine to send.

result.visit_required: The patient is asked to come in. Nothing goes to a pharmacy.
result.more_info: The patient is asked for more. Every medicine waits for the reply.

rx.confirmNote: The patient is notified. The prescription itself is still written at a visit or teleconsultation.
rx.movedBody: Something changed at {{time}}, such as a patient's reply or a colleague's action. Your choices are kept; look again before sending.
rx.deviceBody: Another device is deciding this request too. Choose which one to use.
rx.onlyFired: Only answers that fired a rule
rx.noMonitoring: No tests or readings are required for this class.
rx.writeTeam: Write to clinic and pharmacy colleagues
rx.physicianDecides: Physicians decide. You can assign, message the team or message the patient.
rx.notNow: The status is "{{status}}". No decision is needed.
rx.urgentTitle: An answer points to an emergency
rx.urgentBody: The fixed emergency notice was shown and a ticket opened. Contact the patient before handling the request.

record.staffNotesBody: Patients cannot see these. Write only what care needs.
record.pin: Pin to the top of the record

record.noProfile: The patient has no health profile yet.

oversight.title: Oversight
oversight.lede: The protocol check next to physicians' decisions. It tests the protocol, not physicians.
oversight.phaseTitle: Phase {{n}}: a physician reviews every request
oversight.phaseBody: Physicians decide every medicine of every renewal request. Nothing is approved automatically.
oversight.phaseNext: The protocol's next phase would need 250 requests per drug class, agreement above a threshold, and ethics and regulatory approval. It is not implemented here.
oversight.formula: Agreement = (check "complete" and physician agreed, or check "visit suggested" or "urgent" and physician chose visit or declined) ÷ decided. Requests the check left to the physician, and requests for more information, do not count.
oversight.empty: No renewal requests in this period
oversight.timeNote: Renewals only. The returned share is of requests that reached a pharmacy.
oversight.noRed: No red flags in this period.
oversight.guardNote: The program checks AI replies before they are sent and rewrites or replaces those that hit a rule.
oversight.noGuard: Nothing was stopped in this period.

verdict.prescription_request: Asks for a prescription or dose

rules.title: Rules
rules.lede: The rules the program uses, read only. Changes go through review and update the data files.

note.red_flags: Every patient message is checked first. A hit shows the fixed emergency text; the model has no part in it.
note.scope: On a hit the AI does not answer; fixed text is shown and a ticket may be opened.
note.refill: Days and windows for chronic refills. The program calculates them; the model has no part in it.
note.protocols: Questions and rules for renewals. The result decides what the physician sees, never an approval.
note.formulary: Whether each medicine can be requested online, and why.

rules.noMatchBody: Try another word or another tab.

notif.lede: New tickets, red flags, items to review and overdue requests.
notif.emptyBody: You are notified of previsits, requests, red flags and requests running late.
